description: The dbip vendor module (SID_MODULES=geo,dbip, mode fill, the default): the country for the client IP from DB-IP's IP to Country Lite database, built in at build time, as ortb2.device.geo.country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, type 2, no ipservice). The suite's build has the fixture table the package ships with, which knows only documentation addresses: 192.0.2.0/25 FR, 192.0.2.128/25 XK (no alpha-3 code), 198.51.100.0/24 JP, 203.0.113.0/24 BR, 2001:db8::/48 FR, 2001:db8:1::/48 JP. In fill mode it sends a country only when the platform gives the geo module none. The country is coarse location, sent whatever the consent signals. Requests carry the client IP as X-Forwarded-For (with SID_TRUST_PROXY) and CF-Connecting-IP (Workers), and the CDN's country as cf-ipcountry.

cases.name: fills in the country for an IPv4 address when the CDN has none
fills in the country for an IPv6 address
fills in the country when the CDN's has no alpha-3 code (Tor, T1)
returns nothing for an address the database doesn't know
returns nothing for a country without an alpha-3 code
sends the country with Global Privacy Control and for a COPPA request
